title: A failed lane proposes a brief-template edit that is accepted only on a replay gain
body:
Why: research 1114g (Agentic Harness Engineering, arXiv 2604.25850) shows a harness improving itself from its own failure log; KRN lane failures today become hand-written tasks only when the lead notices them.
Outcome: a failed or reworked lane run emits a proposed edit to the lane brief template or worker rules; the proposal is accepted only when a replay over recorded lanes (evals/fr40) shows no regression and a gain on the failing case.
Proof: a test feeds a recorded failing lane and gets one proposal; a replay harness run prints the before/after verdict that gates acceptance.
